skill.name: eightctl
skill.description: Control Eight Sleep pods from an AI assistant using the eightctl command-line tool.
skill.summary: Manage Eight Sleep pod status, temperature, alarms, schedules, audio, and base controls through eightctl.
skill.author: aiskillstore

security_audit.summary: The skill intentionally invokes the eightctl CLI to control Eight Sleep hardware and uses local or environment-based credentials. No prompt injection or malicious instructions were found, but device-control actions and credential handling require confirmation and user care.

remediation.issue: The skill documents password-based authentication through config files and environment variables.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users not to paste credentials into chats, logs, shared terminals, or repository files. Prefer existing local configuration when possible.

remediation.issue: The skill can change physical device state, including temperature, alarms, audio, and base angle.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the existing guidance to confirm before changes, and require explicit user approval for any command that modifies device state.

content.user_title: Control Eight Sleep Pods with AI
content.value_statement: Eight Sleep settings can be hard to inspect or change while you work in an AI assistant. This skill lets Claude, Codex, or Claude Code help run eightctl commands for pod status, temperature, alarms, schedules, audio, and base controls.
actual_capabilities: Check Eight Sleep pod status through the eightctl CLI.
Turn the pod on or off after user confirmation.
Set pod temperature with an explicit eightctl temperature command.
List, create, or dismiss alarms using eightctl alarm commands.
List, create, or update schedules using eightctl schedule commands.
Control supported audio and base functions through eightctl.
limitations: Requires the eightctl binary to be installed before use.
Requires valid Eight Sleep authentication through local config or environment variables.
Uses an unofficial API that may be rate-limited or change without notice.
Cannot safely change temperature, alarms, schedules, audio, or base angle without explicit user confirmation.

use_cases.title: Check bed status before sleep
use_cases.description: Ask the assistant to inspect pod status and report whether the device is ready.

use_cases.title: Adjust nightly comfort settings
use_cases.description: Set a requested pod temperature after confirming the exact target value and side.

use_cases.title: Manage alarms and schedules
use_cases.description: Review, create, update, or dismiss sleep alarms and schedules through eightctl commands.

prompt_templates.title: Check my pod status
prompt_templates.prompt: Use eightctl to check my Eight Sleep pod status and summarize the result.

prompt_templates.title: Set a safe temperature
prompt_templates.prompt: Set my Eight Sleep pod temperature to 20 degrees only after showing me the exact command and asking for confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Review alarms
prompt_templates.prompt: List my Eight Sleep alarms with eightctl and explain which alarms are active, inactive, or need attention.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a schedule update
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my current Eight Sleep schedules, propose a weekday sleep schedule, and wait for approval before running any update command.

output_examples.input: Check my Eight Sleep pod status.
output_examples.output: Your pod is reachable. It is currently on, connected, and reporting the latest available status from eightctl.
I can set the pod temperature to 20 degrees. Please confirm before I run the command because it changes your physical device.
I found your configured alarms and grouped them by active state. Review the list before asking me to create, dismiss, or change one.

best_practices: Confirm every command that changes temperature, alarms, schedules, audio, or base angle.
Use an existing local eightctl configuration instead of sharing credentials in chat.
Avoid repeated login attempts because the unofficial API may rate-limit requests.
anti_patterns: Do not paste Eight Sleep passwords into prompts, tickets, or shared logs.
Do not run mutating commands when the target side, temperature, alarm, or schedule is unclear.
Do not use the skill for repeated polling that may trigger rate limits.

faq.question: What does this skill control?
faq.answer: It helps use eightctl to control Eight Sleep pod status, power, temperature, alarms, schedules, audio, and base functions.

faq.question: Does it install eightctl automatically?
faq.answer: The skill declares a Go-based install method, but the eightctl binary must be available before commands can run.

faq.question: How does authentication work?
faq.answer: eightctl uses either a local config file or EIGHTCTL_EMAIL and EIGHTCTL_PASSWORD environment variables.

faq.question: Is it safe to share my password with the assistant?
faq.answer: No. Use local configuration or environment variables, and avoid putting credentials in chat or committed files.

faq.question: Will it ask before changing my bed settings?
faq.answer: It should ask before changes. You should require confirmation for temperature, alarms, schedules, audio, and base actions.

faq.question: Why can requests fail?
faq.answer: The Eight Sleep API used by eightctl is unofficial and may be rate-limited or changed by the service.
